channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: FLUX.2-small-decoder and gemma-4-12B-it models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2-small-decoder and Google's gemma-4-12B-it models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: langcache-embed-v3-small, Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking, and LightOnOCR-2-1B models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: Redis's langcache-embed-v3-small, JetBrains' Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking, and LightOn's LightOnOCR-2-1B models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances now available in AWS South America (São Paulo) region
item.description: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7in-24TB instances (u7in-24tb.224xlarge) are now available in AWS South America (São Paulo) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: GLM-5.2 FP8, NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2 and GLM-OCR models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: Z.ai's GLM-5.2 FP8, NVIDIA's Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2, and Z.ai's GLM-OCR models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon GameLift Streams Now Offers Service-managed Shader Caching
item.description: Amazon GameLift Streams now manages shader cache capture and distribution for your applications. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 introduces application status checks
item.description: Amazon EC2 introduces application status checks, a new status check that helps customers detect and respond to application-level issues on their EC2 instances. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Java News Roundup: Shenandoah GC, TeamCity CVE, A2A Java SDK, Camel, Gradle, GlassFish, Groovy
